note: F2 [Broken] from docs/art/variant-families-v1.md, approved 2026-07-30. RESOLVED WITHOUT GENERATING -- the owner pointed at an existing PixelLab group (a8770a41-6493-41be-b141-e21bc507783b, 37 states) which already contained the pair. Zero credits spent. 'Machine' was always the mechanism, not the fiction (see variant-families-v1.md F2); the states that fit are undead, which is a better fiction for an intact/wrecked pair than machines were.

base.note: Group holds 37 states across three hue clusters. This family uses two from the yellow-green cluster (46-62 deg). The base character itself ('A black ghost with sharp') is in the blue cluster and is NOT used here.

axis.name: topology
axis.description: Asymmetry-by-damage. One creature at opposite ends of the asymmetry axis -- intact 0.07, wrecked 0.38 -- with solidity falling in step (0.76 to 0.63). The DELTA is the family read. No friendly does this: each of the six soldiers sits at one fixed asymmetry and stays there.

constant: One bulky upright brute, yellow-green palette (hue 58-62 deg), 88px canvas, 8 directions.

variants.silhouette_target: broad, blocky, heavy-shouldered, dense -- reads whole
the same brute sagging to one side, narrower, less dense -- reads wrecked, not ragged

checks_run: Hue clustering across all 37 states: no state falls in the green band (70-160 deg). The yellow-green cluster at 46-62 deg is the one the owner meant; cyan/blue ooze cluster (188-220 deg) and three strays excluded.

Visual confirmation that the pair reads as ONE creature whole vs wrecked -- measurement alone cannot judge this, and it eliminated the numerically-better pair (Reshape_this_undead_8 -> Keep_this_exact_lops_2 moved three measures the right way but reads as two different creatures: upright brute vs splayed low quadruped).
Keep_this_exact_broa_2 carries a 0.55 aspect-drift WATCH from silhouette_report. North frame inspected as instructed: form stays coherent, drift is view-dependent aspect only. Accepted.
open: Intact half measures asymmetry 0.07, just above soldier06's 0.05. That is a thin margin against the roster's most symmetric friendly -- the two should be compared at horde scale before this ships.
docs/art/variant-families-v1.md section 5.5: regularity carries friend/foe alone for both approved families. F1 [Mirror] is still the decisive test and has not been run.

Duplicate outlines exist in the group (Keep_this_exact_tall == Reshape_this_undead; Keep_this_exact_tria == Reshape_this_undead_3). Not used here, but they should not both be treated as distinct states later.
